supported_components.finding: The FY2024 Part D improper-payment measure is based on CY2022 payments.
CMS selected individual Prescription Drug Event records for documentation review; each sampled record receives a CMS-assigned PDE ID.
The CMS FY2024 Improper Payments Fact Sheet describes the Part D review as a statistically valid stratified random sample of PDEs.
Sampled PDE records are routed to the corresponding Part D sponsor contract through the HPMS Part D IPM Module and PDE Record Identifier spreadsheet.
The identifier spreadsheet supplies ten data elements that uniquely identify each PDE record to be validated.
Supporting documentation must correspond to the sampled PDE version submitted for Part D reconciliation by the June 29, 2023 final PDE submission deadline.
CMS states that the FY2024 Part D IPM complied with OMB guidance on sampling and estimation plans and produced a statistically valid methodology.
FY2024 follows methodology changes implemented for FY2023; CMS treats FY2024 as a baseline and does not treat it as comparable with reporting years before FY2023.

unsupported_or_missing_components: sampling-frame definition, construction, coverage, and frame size
stratum definitions and number of strata
sample allocation across strata, sponsors, contracts, beneficiaries, or PDE categories
selection procedure within strata or other sampling domains
unit selection probabilities or inclusion probabilities
randomization method, seed, ordering, and reproducibility details
replacement, duplicate-unit, ineligible-unit, and nonresponse treatment
relationship between the sampled PDE review and any separately described beneficiary sample
sample weights and their connection to projection, variance, and confidence-limit calculations
non_evidence: The guide's examples showing two or five PDE records illustrate file naming and upload mechanics; they are not the national sample size.
A statistically valid designation does not disclose the frame, strata, allocation, selection probabilities, weights, or reproducible selection procedure.
Sponsor-specific PDE lists in HPMS describe operational routing after selection, not the construction of the national sample.

field_review.remaining_need: A same-period FY2024 sampling-method source disclosing the national sample size, frame and coverage, strata and allocation, within-domain selection procedure and probabilities, replacement or nonresponse rules, and the relationship between PDE selection and any beneficiary-level sample.

evidence_boundaries: This record establishes only disclosed components and an evidence ceiling; it does not close sample design.
Operational documentation-review rules do not disclose a reproducible probability-sample design.
Statistical validity does not establish that every sampled discrepancy is fraud, waste, debt, collectible loss, recovery, prevention, or savings.
No inference may be made from a current or separately described beneficiary sample to the FY2024 CY2022 PDE design without same-period linkage.
